courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 英國一號高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」與「側風力與翻覆力矩」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；英國一號高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Communication delay and stale position" and "Crosswind force and overturning moment" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of High Speed 1 must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦跨區高速線分期銜接與控制互通；英國一號高速鐵路則以跨海高速接線都市隧道與國際轉乘為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on phased high speed connections and control interoperability; High Speed 1 centres on international high speed links urban tunnels and interchange, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」與「隧道壓力波傳遞」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到英國一號高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「折返作業與路徑占用」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Communication delay and stale position” and “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High Speed 1, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Turnback and route occupation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 麥加—麥地那高速鐵路

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」與「砂塵沉積與清理週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到麥加—麥地那高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「月台暫存與隊列守恆」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Communication delay and stale position” and “Dust deposition and cleaning interval”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Haramain high-speed railway, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Platform storage and queue conservation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.summary: 法國東歐高速鐵路：跨區高速線分期銜接與控制互通。
courses.summaryEn: LGV Est europeenne: Phased high speed connections and control interoperability.
courses.connection: 從「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」追到「並聯備援與共同原因」；地圖提供公開工程的地理脈絡。
courses.connectionEn: Trace the structure from “Communication delay and stale position” to “Parallel redundancy and common cause”; the map gives public geographic context.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 法國東歐高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2007 年：法國東歐高速鐵路第一期開始營運；2016 年：法國東歐高速鐵路第二期開始營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2007: The first phase of LGV Est europeenne entered service; 2016: The second phase of LGV Est europeenne entered service. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 本課把「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」到「並聯備援與共同原因」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
